projects.title: Profile Card
projects.tagline: A polished profile card built from scratch.
projects.outcome: A centered card with an avatar, name, bio, and button — one HTML file you can open in any browser.

projects.title: Quiz Game
projects.tagline: An interactive multiple-choice quiz with scoring.
projects.outcome: A working 3-question quiz that tracks your score and lets you play again.

projects.title: To-Do List App
projects.tagline: Add, complete, and delete tasks that persist.
projects.outcome: A to-do app whose tasks survive a refresh, saved with localStorage.

projects.title: Greeting Script
projects.tagline: A Bash script that greets you by name and time of day.
projects.outcome: An executable shell script that says good morning/afternoon/evening, personalised to you.

projects.title: Number Guessing Game
projects.tagline: A guess-the-number game with hot/cold hints.
projects.outcome: A C program that picks a secret number and guides you to it with higher/lower hints.

projects.title: Bank Account
projects.tagline: An OOP bank account with deposits and withdrawals.
projects.outcome: A BankAccount class with deposit, withdraw, and balance — your first real object-oriented program.
